summary: Backend-only V1.5 pytest suite executed against https://flight-fit-plans.preview.emergentagent.com. 37/41 functional tests PASSING across auth (JWT), extended onboarding (HomeEquipmentBody), roster extract/confirm/current/history with expiry buckets, hotels search + upsert + attach, workouts generate-month (33 workouts w/ full V1.5 shape incl. warmup/alternatives/rationale/location), workouts patch coach_locked+location, workouts regenerate scope=dates preserving coach_locked, coach clients/dashboard filters (7 filters + all)/client detail with roster_history, exercises CRUD auth guards, checkins, nutrition (meal + summary), progress, messages (thread + partners). 2 confirmed backend bugs: (1) POST /api/register-push returns HTTP 500 with placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY when spec requires 201 non-blocking, (2) Exercises seed carries over 12 rows from V1 — new V1.5 seed of 20 exercises is never applied because seed() only inserts when count==0. 1 infra/perf issue: POST /api/workouts/generate-month takes ~238s end-to-end which exceeds the ~60s Cloudflare edge timeout on the preview URL (returns 502). Endpoint itself is functionally correct (verified via localhost:8001). No react-native issues to report (backend only).

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 {"detail":"EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid"} when upstream Emergent Push returns 401 (placeholder key). Spec: endpoint must NOT 500 and must return 201 {status: registered} in non-blocking fashion. Root cause: server.py:459-460 explicitly raises HTTPException(500,...) on resp.status_code==401, then re-raises inside the outer try/except HTTPException branch — bypassing the 'non-blocking' warning path. Fix: remove the 401→500 mapping (or wrap it in a broader except so it becomes a logger.warning) so the function falls through to `return {"status": "registered"}`.

Public preview URL returns 502 Bad Gateway (Cloudflare edge timeout ~60s) — endpoint takes ~238s to complete a full-month Claude Sonnet 4.5 generation. Verified functional via http://localhost:8001 (200 OK, 33 workouts, correct shape). Fix suggestions: (a) generate week-by-week and stream, (b) return a job id + poll pattern, (c) reduce prompt/output token count, (d) invoke Claude with lower max_out or chunked calls. Impact: end-user flow is broken on mobile because the app cannot wait 60+s for a response.

minor.issue: DB currently returns only 12 exercises. DEFAULT_EXERCISES in server.py has 20 entries but seed() at line 1185 only inserts when count_documents({}) == 0 — since V1 already seeded 12 rows, the additional 8 rows (Bulgarian Split Squat, Dead Bug, Overhead Press, 90/90 Hip Rotation, Kettlebell Swing, Pike Push-Up, Split Squat, Farmer Carry, Glute Bridge, Bent-Over Row band, Incline Walk treadmill, Assault Bike Zone 2) are never inserted. Fix: change guard to per-name upsert (loop and `db.exercises.update_one({name:...},{upsert:True})`) so V1.5 additions materialise on existing databases.

action_items: HIGH: Rewrite /api/register-push to swallow upstream 401 as a non-blocking warning (return 201 {status:'registered'}) — currently 500s with placeholder key.

HIGH: Address /api/workouts/generate-month exceeding Cloudflare 60s edge timeout. Suggest chunked (per-week) generation, streaming, or async job pattern. Endpoint itself works — infra timeout is the blocker.
MEDIUM: Change seed() exercise guard from `if count == 0` to per-name upsert so V1.5's 20-exercise catalogue actually materialises on already-seeded DBs (currently stuck at 12).
LOW: Consider making score_load also downgrade layover-arrival to amber if it directly precedes home base (roster spec ambiguous). Current implementation returns red — tests pass with red.
STYLE ONLY (not blocking): ruff E701/E702/F541 warnings in server.py — single-line `x=1; y=2` and `if x: y` — safe to leave for later cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 1211 lines exceeds the 700-line guideline — recommend splitting into routers (auth, roster, workouts, hotels, coach, nutrition, messages) + services.
seed() exercise catalogue is only inserted when the collection is empty — will silently skip V1.5 additions on any DB seeded under V1. Anti-pattern for evolving seed data.
register-push has an internal try/except but the 401→HTTPException(500) branch re-raises through the HTTPException catch, defeating the intended non-blocking behaviour.
score_load returns 'red' for 'layover arrival' with no consideration of report/duty times — acceptable per spec, but may need nuance later.
Long-running LLM endpoints (generate-month) have no timeout / job pattern — clients will time out at CDN before completion.
MongoDB _id is correctly stripped in all endpoints via clean_doc() and projection ({"_id":0}) — good.
All endpoints under /api and use Pydantic validation — good.
JWT verification, role guard, coach-only endpoints all verified working.

rca_of_issue: Bug 1 (register-push 500): In server.py:455-468, when upstream Emergent Push returns 401 (placeholder key), code path is `if resp.status_code == 401: raise HTTPException(500, ...)`. The outer `except HTTPException: raise` re-raises it, bypassing the non-blocking `return {status:'registered'}` line. Reproduce: POST /api/register-push {user_id,platform,device_token} → 500. Fix: convert the 401 raise into a logger.warning + fall-through OR add HTTPException to the broad except so it's swallowed. Bug 2 (only 12 exercises): server.py:1185 `if await db.exercises.count_documents({}) == 0:` prevents V1.5 additions from being inserted into a DB that already had V1's 12 rows. Reproduce: fresh DB seeds 20; upgraded DB stays at 12. Fix: per-name upsert loop.
